## Why it matters

ZEFYS provides free access to digitized historical newspapers from the Staatsbibliothek zu Berlin, including title lists, issue calendars, and selected full-text search.

It is especially useful for German press history because it combines pre-1945 newspapers with dedicated corpora such as the Prussian official press and DDR press portal.
